quote.pt: Pablo é um dos profissionais mais completos do time. Ele se destaca pela velocidade e qualidade das entregas, sempre demonstrando muita dedicação, responsabilidade e vontade de fazer acontecer.
quote.en: Pablo is one of the most well-rounded professionals on the team. He stands out for the speed and quality of his work, always showing great dedication, responsibility and drive to make things happen.

quote.en: Pablo is an excellent teammate, always communicative and collaborative. He has an impressive technical command of Flutter and is a reference.
